name: Newsletter
description: Visitor newsletter subscriptions (double opt-in when mail is configured, single opt-in fallback otherwise), subscriber management with CSV export, and HTML campaign composing/sending with per-subscriber unsubscribe links. Ships a Verso 'Newsletter' subscribe block.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Run the plugin's own compiled interface in the browser: its admin page and its Verso block (in the editor and on public pages). Without it the host does not serve these bundles and that interface does not load.
Read subscribers and campaigns from the plugin's own wjp_ tables.
Create the plugin's tables and store subscribers, confirmation tokens and campaigns.
Public subscribe/confirm/unsubscribe endpoints and the admin management API.
Add the Newsletter entry to the admin sidebar.
Send double opt-in confirmation emails and newsletter campaigns.
